title: Diabetes Health Indicators
summary: A Clinical Decision Support System for Chronic Kidney Disease that uses a Bayesian Neural Network for diagnosis with uncertainty quantification, alongside computer vision for dipstick image reading and a RAG chat agent for guideline queries. Its preprocessing pipeline fits an SDV TVAESynthesizer on training data to generate synthetic samples for class-imbalance augmentation before model training.
evidence: src/preprocessing/preprocess_pima.py:72-79: TVAESynthesizer(metadata, epochs=300, batch_size=64); synthesizer.fit/sample used to augment training data
